stories.title: El Niño: Understanding the weather-disrupting event and why it could break records this year
stories.summary: The El Niño climate anomaly, which occurs in the Pacific every two to seven years, triggers droughts and floods, disrupts entire sectors of the economy, and raises global temperatures.
